Despite the brevity of the script, the two main characters, Jan and Thomas, are developed as complex characters through strong subtext and specific physical actions. Details like Jan nervously stirring an empty cup and keeping his jacket on his lap, or Thomas still wearing the watch and admitting he wrote a message despite not knowing what to say, give them realistic emotional depth and a palpable shared history. Meanwhile, the waitress is appropriately kept as a flat, minor character; her brief appearances naturally fit the café setting and are effectively used to pace the scene and highlight the main characters' intense focus on each other (such as when neither thanks her).
